concerns: The accelerator has no functioning synthesized implementation: the testbench was set as the synthesis top, producing zero retained cells and an empty netlist.

No empirical evaluation exists; FPGA resource, power, frame rate, and detection accuracy tables are filled with TBD placeholders, and the conclusion defers detector training and dataset evaluation to future work.

The reported power and waveform outputs are preliminary and invalidated by the empty-netlist synthesis and an incomplete transaction trace (start and done both low), so the limited hardware results do not corroborate the architectural claims.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: Because the proposed accelerator lacks a functioning synthesized implementation, functional verification against a golden model, and any empirical detection accuracy or hardware measurements, it remains an unfinished proposal unsuitable for confident promotion.

blocking_reasons: The accelerator has no functioning synthesized implementation: the testbench was set as the synthesis top, producing zero retained cells and an empty netlist.

No empirical evaluation exists; FPGA resource, power, frame rate, and detection accuracy tables are filled with TBD placeholders, and the conclusion defers detector training and dataset evaluation to future work.

The reported power and waveform outputs are preliminary and invalidated by the empty-netlist synthesis and an incomplete transaction trace (start and done both low), so the limited hardware results do not corroborate the architectural claims.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: No independent measurement is reported; the manuscript states that synthesis, power, and dataset measurements were not contained in the source material, with results tables left as TBD placeholders.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: The headline outcomes are analytical throughput and storage estimates derived from the same architectural parameterization.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The precision-assignment policy is driven by sensitivity-based detection-loss calibration during training.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: The authors explicitly acknowledge that synthesis, implementation, timing closure, power measurement, and dataset evaluations (e.g., PASCAL VOC/COCO mAP) were not completed and remain future work.
primary.evaluation_assessment: No empirical evaluation is completed. The manuscript contains only pre-synthesis analytical estimates, a static device power report on an empty netlist, an incomplete behavioral simulation waveform, and templates filled with 'TBD' values for FPGA utilization, frame rate, and detection accuracy.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: No empirical measurements or model evaluations are reported in the manuscript; results tables consist of TBD placeholders.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Theoretical peak MAC/TOPS throughput formulas and unpopulated experimental tables.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Analytical design equations and sensitivity-based precision assignment planning.

primary.limitations: The authors candidly state limitations and threats to validity, specifically that empirical validation on datasets and actual FPGA resource/power metrics are completely pending.
primary.method_assessment: While the architectural concepts and analytical formulas are described, the hardware implementation is incomplete; the authors note that the synthesis testbench was accidentally set as the top module, optimizing away the logic and leaving an empty netlist.
primary.quality_rationale: Because the proposed accelerator lacks a functioning synthesized implementation, functional verification against a golden model, and any empirical detection accuracy or hardware measurements, it remains an unfinished proposal unsuitable for confident promotion.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper proposes FlexXNOR-OD, an FPGA accelerator architecture concept for object detection featuring channel-group variable-precision scheduling and lane-fusible XNOR processing elements.

scholarly_quality.rationale: Because the proposed accelerator lacks a functioning synthesized implementation, functional verification against a golden model, and any empirical detection accuracy or hardware measurements, it remains an unfinished proposal unsuitable for confident promotion.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors candidly state limitations and threats to validity, specifically that empirical validation on datasets and actual FPGA resource/power metrics are completely pending.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
